documents.title: Raft notes
documents.text: Raft is a consensus algorithm. The leader election picks a leader. Log replication keeps the replicated log consistent.

documents.title: Paxos notes
documents.text: Paxos is another consensus algorithm requiring a quorum for each decision.

documents.title: CAP theorem
documents.text: In distributed systems, partition tolerance means the network partition cannot break consensus.

documents.title: Leader duties
documents.text: The leader sends heartbeats; without a leader, a new election starts.

documents.title: Quorum reads
documents.text: A quorum of replicas must acknowledge log replication before the leader commits.

documents.title: Split brain
documents.text: A split brain happens when partition tolerance is violated and two leaders emerge.

documents.title: State machines
documents.text: A replicated state machine applies the same log replication to each state machine.

documents.title: Membership
documents.text: In distributed systems a quorum elects the leader; consensus needs a majority.
